purpose: Define the explicit evidence bridge from completed Project work to MeritCore without embedding MeritCore scoring semantics inside Project.

topics.name: Project Merit Evidence
topics.purpose: Define the explicit evidence bridge from completed Project work to MeritCore without embedding MeritCore scoring semantics inside Project.

semantics.ownership_rule: Project owns Project/work outcomes and evidence refs; MeritCore owns merits, points, Tier, recommendations and trust calculations.
semantics.bridge_rule: Project produces evidence package; MeritCore evaluates/records eligible merit semantics.
semantics.identity_rule: Evidence maps explicitly to participant identities.
semantics.time_rule: Evidence carries relevant Project time atoms/time provenance.
semantics.feedback_rule: Project feedback/recommendation context may be referenced but MeritCore owns recommendation/trust interpretation.
semantics.no_score_rule: Project does not calculate MeritCore points/Tier itself.

invariants.rule: Project/task, execution, evidence and merit semantics are explicit and non-duplicated.

hard_gates.condition: Merit evidence lacks explicit participant identity
Project feedback silently becomes trust without MeritCore policy
same underlying work submitted as duplicated merit evidence

prose.summary: Define the explicit evidence bridge from completed Project work to MeritCore without embedding MeritCore scoring semantics inside Project.
notes: Unlocked until reconciled against existing FreeMarket/Project/Merit contracts and repository-wide Contract Format 1.4 validation.
